Registered on Stellar testnet (home chain) in the AXON Agent Registry with an on-chain identity and reputation record, and accountable on Concordium: a verified human stands behind it (Verified by Concordium badge, identity never revealed), its spending is checked against a cap set by its verified owner, and it pays for gated services via x402 with sponsored fees.
